About the Scholarship

GEM is the Erasmus Mundus master in geo-information science and earth observation for environmental modelling and management, coordinated from the University of Twente's ITC faculty. Applications for the 2027-2029 edition close on 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET, with selection results due on 31 March 2027.

OpportunityGEM – Erasmus Mundus Master in Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation
HostGEM Consortium (University of Twente)
LocationEnschede (multi-country mobility), Netherlands
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline15 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

GEM is the Erasmus Mundus master in geo-information science and earth observation for environmental modelling and management, coordinated from the University of Twente's ITC faculty. Applications for the 2027-2029 edition close on 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET, with selection results due on 31 March 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • ITC Twente's geospatial specialisation with a multi-university mobility path
  • Clear timeline: 15 January 2027 deadline, 31 March results, September start
  • Strong applied focus on environmental modelling with satellite data
  • Alumni in geospatial agencies, climate services and location-intelligence companies

Who Should Apply

A bachelor's of at least 180 ECTS in environmental science, geography, engineering, computer science or a neighbouring field is expected, along with English proficiency documentation.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships: tuition coverage plus monthly allowance, travel and installation support for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the University of Twente's DreamApply portal before 15 January 2027 and keep certified documents ready for the March review. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (23:59 CET); results expected 31 March 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About GEM Consortium (University of Twente)

The GEM consortium is coordinated by the University of Twente's ITC faculty and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation for Environmental Modelling and Management with European partners.

Official website: https://www.gem-msc.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
